items.title: Mary Collins Interview, 1974-09-29
items.q: Louis Armstrong and Gary Crosby were there in Chicago, Chicago Theater.

ctx.x: Who played, who showed for the benefit?

Oh, my goodness. I'm going to get to that. But the benefit was supposed to be given at the Blue Note. Louis Armstrong and Gary Crosby were there in Chicago, Chicago Theater. And something, some reason, I don't know who did it, but they canceled it. So, the musician decided not to give it in Chicago, decided to give it out in the suburbs. They did. So, the Dukes of Dixieland came. And musicians from England, oh, several bands came. And they played for this benefit, which was quite successful. You couldn't get in…
Then he died. Right. Right then.
